title: DebugPilot terminal dashboard layouts
brief: Three structurally distinct, terminal-realistic TUI dashboard proposals for launch profiles, Compose services, and logs. Preserve the existing palette; prioritize compact hierarchy, separated sections, keyboard operation, and narrow terminal adaptation. Every state and Compose transcript shown is illustrative, not an observation.

artboards.title: Log workspace + context sidebar (recommended)
artboards.tradeoff: Best match to the reference: large left log workspace and narrow right status/profile/service cards; keeps context visible but gives the log less horizontal room in narrow terminals.

artboards.title: Project tree + docked output console
artboards.tradeoff: Makes project/service hierarchy and a persistent full-width Compose transcript easy to scan; consumes vertical space and makes output compete with the inventory.

artboards.title: Focus workspace + status strip
artboards.tradeoff: Uses a slim profile rail, horizontal service summaries, and a broad log pane with contextual operations; reduces always-visible detail and relies on keyboard-accessible disclosure for less-used actions.
